answer_4.quote: Humans perform only marginally better than random chance (25%). ... Group 1, 2, 3, and 4 are annotated by native Italian, Chinese, English, and Russian speakers, respectively; they are either postdoc or PhD students in NLP.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were provided with five demonstration examples per class (four classes) and asked to assign the correct generator label for each text.
